issues.feedback: Acceptance criteria 4/5 are not currently satisfiable with the proposed changes alone. In this repo, `nix develop -c cargo check --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl` fails with `E0463` (musl std target missing). Keeping `devShells.default` unchanged and making `.cargo/config.toml` optional does not provision the musl target/linker. Specify a required musl toolchain path (for example a dedicated `devShells.musl`, or explicit rustup target-install step) and make the command context explicit.

The spec says x86_64-linux-musl only, but `flake-utils.eachDefaultSystem` includes Darwin. Making `packages.default = pkgsStatic...` unconditionally can break or mis-specify macOS outputs (musl is Linux-only). Add platform gating (Linux static default, Darwin fallback) or redefine supported systems.

`cargo check/test --target ...musl` are mandatory in Acceptance Criteria, but the implementation section marks `.cargo/config.toml` as optional and depends on external `musl-tools`. This is internally inconsistent; either make local musl cargo support required and fully specified, or scope the criteria to Nix build/test only.

Static-link validation is described as manual commands only. For regression safety, add an automated assertion in the Nix derivation/CI (and handle `ldd` non-zero exit for static binaries, e.g. `ldd ... || true`). Also avoid hard-coded conformance test counts; they drift (current validate list is 80 tests).
